OPERATING GUIDELINES:
- Every turn: output <thought> first, then ONE <tool_call name="write_site"> with exactly one .tsx and one .css <file> pair.
- CSS is MANDATORY. Every section must have real visual rules (colors, typography, spacing, layout). Empty or placeholder CSS is a hard failure.
- Use modern CSS: flexbox/grid for layout, CSS custom properties for design tokens, responsive units (rem/%, vw).
- Write production-quality TypeScript. Keep all types inline — no third-party imports except react and react-dom.
- Reconcile prompt and brief: Honor the content brief data (business name, tagline, tiers) while incorporating any specific interactive capabilities requested in the user prompt (e.g. dark/light mode toggle in Header, active category tabs in Features, annual/monthly billing toggle in Pricing, and next/prev carousel pagination in Testimonials).
- Real Interactive State: For interactive sections (pricing toggles, tab filtering, carousels, mobile menus), write functional React state (`useState`, `useEffect`) rather than static unclickable elements.
- Clean Iconography: Use clean inline SVGs or standard FontAwesome icon classes (e.g. `fa-solid fa-check`, `fa-solid fa-bolt`, `fa-solid fa-star`, `fa-brands fa-github`).
- Do NOT output markdown code fences (```) around your <tool_call> tags.
- Do NOT combine multiple sections into one turn — one section per tool_call only.

.sa-hero {
  width: 100%;

  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;

  display: inline-block;

  font-size: 0.8rem;

  text-transform: uppercase;

  color: #ffffff;

}
.sa-hero__subtitle {
  font-family: Inter, sans-serif;
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.88);
  max-width: 680px;

}
.sa-hero__actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.sa-hero__btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0.8rem 2rem;
  font-family: Inter, sans-serif;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 1rem;

  border-radius: 6px;

  background: #38bdf8;
  color: #1c1917;
}
.sa-hero__btn--primary:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}
.sa-hero__btn--secondary {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  color: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
}
.sa-hero__btn--secondary:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

export interface IWorkItemState extends IWorkItem {
    thumbnailURL: string
    imageURLs: string[]
}

export interface IWrokState {
    isLoading: boolean
    workItems: IWorkItemState[]
}

const initialWorkState: IWrokState = {
    isLoading: false,
    workItems: [{
        title: "",
        skills: [],
        description: "",
        year: "",
        thumbnail: "",
        thumbnailURL: "",
        images: [],
        imageURLs: [],

export const workReducer = reducerWithInitialState(initialWorkState)
    .case(workActions.getWorks.started, (state: IWrokState) => {

    .case(workActions.getWorks.done, (state: IWrokState, success: Success<void, IWorkItem[]>) => {
        return Object.assign({}, state, { workItems: success.result });
    })
    .case(workActions.getThumbnail.done, (state: IWrokState, success: Success<string, string>) => {
        let stateTmp = Object.assign(state);
        stateTmp.isLoading = false;
        stateTmp.workItems
            .filter((workItem: IWorkItemState) => workItem.thumbnail === success.params)
            .map((workItem: IWorkItemState) => workItem.thumbnailURL = success.result)

        return Object.assign({}, state, { stateTmp });
    })
    .case(workActions.getDetailImages.done, (state: IWrokState, success: Success<IWorkItemState | null, string[]>) => {
        if (success.params !== null) {
            const title = success.params.title
            let stateTmp = Object.assign(state);
            stateTmp.workItems
                .filter((work: IWorkItemState) => work.title === title)
                .map((work: IWorkItemState) => work.imageURLs = success.result)

            return Object.assign({}, state, { stateTmp });
        }
